2481.name: Find Treasure
2481.text: Allows the dwarf to sense nearby treasure, making it appear on the minimap. Lasts until canceled.

5227.name: Underwater Breathing
5227.text: Underwater breath lasts 300% longer than normal.

7744.name: Will of the Forsaken
7744.text: Instantly removes all Charm, Fear and Sleep effects.

20549.name: War Stomp
20549.text: Stuns up to 5 enemies within 8 yds for 2 sec.

20550.name: Endurance
20550.text: Total Health increased by 5% and chance to hit increased by 1%.

20552.name: Cultivation
20552.text: Cultivate a nearby herb, growing a duplicate you can harvest without requiring Herbalism skill. Each herb may only be cultivated once.

20554.name: Berserking
20554.text: Increases your spellcasting and attack speed by 10% for 10 sec.

20555.name: Regeneration
20555.text: Health regeneration rate increased by 10%. In addition, 10% of total Health regeneration will continue during combat.

20557.name: Beast Slaying
20557.text: Damage dealt versus Beasts increased by 5%.

20572.name: Blood Fury
20572.text: Increases Attack Power and Spell Power by 10% for 15 sec.

20573.name: Hardiness
20573.text: Duration of Stun effects on you reduced by 20%.

20574.name: Axe Specialization
20574.text: Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and abilities by 1% while you have an axe or a two-handed axe equipped.

20577.name: Cannibalize
20577.text: When activated, regenerates 7% of total Health and 7% of total Mana every 2 sec for 10 sec. Only works on Humanoid or Undead corpses within 5 yds. Any movement, action, or damage taken while Cannibalizing will cancel the effect.

20580.name: Shadowmeld
20580.text: Activate to slip into the shadows, reducing the chance for enemies to detect your presence. Lasts until cancelled or upon moving. Using this ability in combat discourages enemies from attacking you, but increases the cooldown to 2 min.

20582.name: Quickness
20582.text: Dodge chance increased by 1% and movement speed increased by 2%. Night Elf Rogues and Druids are harder to detect in Stealth as if they were 1 level higher.

20585.name: Wisp Spirit
20585.text: Transform into a wisp upon death, increasing movement speed by 75%.

20589.name: Escape Artist
20589.text: Instantly escape the effects of any movement impairing effect and gain immunity to those effects for 3 sec.

20593.name: Engineering Specialization
20593.text: Your gnomish ingenuity reduces the rate of engineering devices failing or backfiring when you use them by 20%.

20594.name: Stoneform
20594.text: Instantly removes and grants immunity to all Bleed, Poison, and Disease effects, and reduces all Physical damage taken by 10% for 8 sec.

20597.name: Sword Specialization
20597.text: Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and attacks by 2% while you have a sword or two-handed sword equipped.

20600.name: Perception
20600.text: Dramatically increases stealth detection for 20 sec.

1259416.name: Walk on Air
1259416.text: Glide downward through the air for 10 sec while controlling your direction of travel.

1259686.name: Skysight
1259686.text: Attempt to draw power from a convergence of elements and receive its blessing, increasing your movement and mounted movement speeds by 10%. Lasts 30 sec if no elemental convergence is nearby, and 15 min if one is found.

1259705.name: Read Ley Line
1259705.text: Attempt to tap into the power of a nearby ley line, increasing your Health and Mana regeneration by 100%. Lasts 15 sec if no ley line is nearby, and 15 min if one is found.

1259707.name: Elemental Insight
1259707.text: Damage dealt versus Elementals increased by 5%.

1259710.name: Wind Blessed
1259710.text: Increases your spellcasting, melee, and ranged Haste by 1%.

1259719.name: Mace Specialization
1259719.text: Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and attacks by 1% while you have a mace or two-handed mace equipped.

1259721.name: Big Game Hunter
1259721.text: Damage dealt versus Beasts increased by 5%.

1259799.name: Elune's Light
1259799.text: Increases your critical strike chance with all spells and attacks by 10% for 15 sec.

1259812.name: Eureka!
1259812.text: Your next 3 non-periodic damaging abilities have their Energy cost reduced by 10% and deal 10% more damage.

1259813.name: Eureka!
1259813.text: Your next 3 non-periodic damaging abilities have their Rage cost reduced by 10% and deal 10% more damage.

1259817.name: Eureka!
1259817.text: Your next 3 damaging abilities have their Mana cost reduced by 10% and deal 10% more damage.

1259821.name: Eureka!
1259821.text: Your next 3 non-periodic damaging abilities have their Mana cost reduced by 10% and deal 10% more damage.

1259823.name: Eureka!
1259823.text: Your next 3 non-periodic damaging or healing abilities have their Mana cost reduced by 10% and deal 10% more damage or healing.

1259918.name: Plainsrunning
1259918.text: Gain 1% increased movement speed every 5 sec spent moving, up to a maximum of 30% increase. Taking damage or standing still will reduce this effect.

1260189.name: Touch of the Grave
1260189.text: Your spells and attacks have a 5% chance to drain Health from the target, up to 5% of your maximum Health.

1260201.name: Touch of the Grave
1260201.text: Your spells and attacks have a 10% chance to drain Health from the target, up to 5% of your maximum Health.

1260270.name: Rapid Regeneration
1260270.text: Regenerate 50% of your maximum Health over 6 sec. Any movement, action, or damage taken will cancel the effect.

1299026.name: Shatter Curse
1299026.text: Instantly removes and grants immunity to all Curses and Banes, and reduces all Magical damage taken by 15% for 8 sec.

priest:Chastise: Chastise the target, causing 272 to 306 Holy damage and Immobilizing them for up to 2 sec. Only works against Humanoids. This spell causes very low threat.
priest:Confounding Flash: Confuses up to 5 enemies within 8 yds for 3 sec. Any damage taken will break the effect.
priest:Contingency Plan: Place a Holy ward on an ally for 30 sec. The next time this ally takes damage dropping their Health below 35%, they will gain a shield absorbing 926 damage and begin healing for 670 Health over 15 sec. A target may be affected by only one Contingency Plan.
priest:Dark Sacrifice: Cannibalize 1640 of your own Health over 15 sec to gain (1640 + Spirit) Mana.
priest:Desperate Prayer: Instantly heals the caster for 1318 to 1546.
priest:Divine Grace: Instantly heals a friendly target below 50% Health for 1318 to 1546 and removes Weakened Soul from that target. Cannot be cast on self.
priest:Elune's Grace: Reduces the chance you'll be hit by melee and ranged attacks by 50% for 15 sec or until you are missed 3 times.
priest:Feedback: The priest becomes surrounded with anti-magic energy. Any successful spell cast against the priest will burn 105 of the attacker's Mana, causing 1 Shadow damage for each point of Mana burned. Lasts 15 sec.
priest:Hex of Weakness: Weakens the target enemy, reducing melee attack power by 204 and reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 20%. Lasts 2 min
priest:Shadowguard: The caster is surrounded by shadows. When a spell, melee or ranged attack hits the caster, the attacker will be struck for 96 Shadow damage. Attackers can only be damaged once every few seconds. This damage causes no threat. 3 charges. Lasts 10 min.
priest:Starshards: Rains starshards down on the enemy target's head, causing 1800 Arcane damage over 6 sec.
priest:Touch of Weakness: The next melee attack on the caster will cause 56 Shadow damage and reduce the attacker's melee attack power by the attacker by 204 for 2 min.
